description: This is a Java source file defining an Android activity class 'PersistentState' that demonstrates using SharedPreferences to persist and restore UI state across activity lifecycle events.

classes.name: PersistentState
classes.description: An Android Activity class that manages a simple UI with text input, demonstrating persistence of text and selection state using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, updates a TextView message, and retrieves the EditText widget.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores the text and selection state from SharedPreferences when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Saves the current text and selection state to SharedPreferences when the activity is paused.
